company.name: GM Furniture
company.description: GM Furniture is a leading Ethiopian manufacturer and supplier of modern office and household furniture. Established in Addis Ababa, the company uses imported machinery and skilled Ethiopian craftsmen to produce high-quality furniture at competitive prices.
company.factory: Alemgena, Sebeta Wereda — about 5 minutes from Jemo

delivery_info.addis_ababa: Free delivery within Addis Ababa for orders above 10,000 birr. Standard delivery 2-3 business days.
delivery_info.outside_addis: Delivery available to major cities. Shipping cost calculated based on distance. Delivery time 5-7 business days.
delivery_info.installation: Free installation included with all furniture purchases. Our technicians will assemble and set up at your location.

company.warranty: 1 year warranty on all products. 3 year warranty on office furniture frames.
company.custom_orders: Custom furniture orders accepted. Design consultation available at showrooms. Production time 2-4 weeks depending on complexity.

faq.question: Do you deliver outside Addis Ababa?
faq.answer: Yes, we deliver to major cities across Ethiopia. Delivery within Addis Ababa is free for orders above 10,000 birr. For outside Addis, shipping costs are calculated based on distance.
faq.answer_amharic: አዎ፣ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ባሉ ዋና ከተሞች ዴሊቨሪ እናደርጋለን። በአዲስ አበባ ውስጥ ከ10,000 ብር በላይ ለሆኑ ትዕዛዞች ዴሊቨሪ ነፃ ነው።

faq.question: Do you do custom/made-to-order furniture?
faq.answer: Yes! We accept custom orders. Visit any showroom for a design consultation. Production takes 2-4 weeks depending on complexity.
faq.answer_amharic: አዎ! ብጁ ትዕዛዞችን እንቀበላለን። ለዲዛይን ምክክር ወደ ማንኛውም ሾሩም ይምጡ። ምርት ከ2-4 ሳምንት ይፈጃል።

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept cash, bank transfer (CBE, Awash, Dashen banks), and installment plans for orders above 50,000 birr.
faq.answer_amharic: በጥሬ ገንዘብ፣ በባንክ ማስተላለፍ (ንግድ ባንክ፣ አዋሽ፣ ዳሸን) እና ከ50,000 ብር በላይ ለሆኑ ትዕዛዞች በክፍያ ቅጣፍ (Installment) መክፈል ይችላሉ።

faq.question: Is installation included?
faq.answer: Yes, free installation is included with all purchases. Our technicians will deliver, assemble and set up your furniture.
faq.answer_amharic: አዎ፣ ነጻ የመትከያ አገልግሎት ከሁሉም ግዢዎች ጋር ተካትቷል። ቴክኒሻኖቻችን ያስረክባሉ፣ ያገጣጥማሉ፣ ያስቀምጣሉ።

faq.question: Do you have a warranty?
faq.answer: Yes, all products come with a 1-year warranty. Office furniture frames have a 3-year warranty.
faq.answer_amharic: አዎ፣ ሁሉም ምርቶች 1 ዓመት ዋስትና አላቸው። የቢሮ ፈርኒቸር ፍሬሞች 3 ዓመት ዋስትና አላቸው።

faq.question: What are your working hours?
faq.answer: We are open Monday to Saturday from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM.
faq.answer_amharic: ከሰኞ እስከ ቅዳሜ ከጠዋቱ 8:30 እስከ ምሽት 6:00 ድረስ ክፍት ነን።
